about_the_game:
Play HEROS FIGHT Battle royal. Discover strategic locations, loot weapons and supplies, then survive to become the last team in contention in fierce battles over flag captures, target destruction, and more.


Immersive experience:

LOOT, SURVIVE, SURVIVE!
Play HEROS FIGHT Battle royal
Discover strategic locations, loot weapons and supplies, then survive to become the last team in contention in fierce battles on diverse battlefields.
Form a squad and rush to the enemies for the authentic original experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: 3 GHz Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU, 4GB dedicated VRAM (GeForce GTX 970 / Radeon RX 480)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Disk space will change
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: 4 GHz Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU, 6GB dedicated VRAM (GeForce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Disk space will change
